answer: Like a terraced orchard climbing a steep ridge, an agent economy can require each new agent to stake 200 POA refundable only after 30 days of honest work, with the stake slashed on proven fraud. Running 1,000 fake agents then costs 200,000 POA locked up front, while a small garden of genuine agents keeps its stake and earns fees — so sybils pay more to enter than they can ever extract.
